question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extremely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the appearance of a quilt that is “ragged and patched, but still clean.”
 
• The missing word should intensify the description of how ragged the quilt is.
 
• **“Extremely”** fits best as it is an adverb used to emphasize a high degree of a quality.
 
• Other options like **“frankly”**, **“eagerly”**, or **“abruptly”** do not describe the condition of an object.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Frankly** – means honestly; used to express truthfulness, not suitable here.
 
• **Eagerly** – means with enthusiasm; does not describe the condition of a quilt.
 
• **Abruptly** – means suddenly; does not fit contextually.
